cpu_fixtures.scope: Dummy child and file/CAS fixtures, fake providers, and installed SDK offline request/origin fixtures; no account calls.
CPU/source checks and native/accelerator tripwires; no native import or cloud execution.

source_review.handoff: Persist DODGE-057 failure disposition before exact non-null predecessor-to-DODGE-059 lease CAS under shared lock; no null clearing or retry path.
source_review.allocation: Single standard T4 request, durable UUID and allocation claim before SDK assign, retries zero, endpoint ownership persisted before private session store; ambiguous response does not infer ownership.
source_review.billing_and_deadlines: Positive quoted rate at or below 3 CU/hour and responsive bounded requests admit work without balance movement. Elapsed time includes suspend; 900-second assignment cap reserves 120 seconds for receipt and teardown; 6 CU estimated/observed cutoff and 8 CU maximum retained.
source_review.termination: Source distinguishes absence observed before coordinator release request from coordinator-requested release; connection/query failure alone does not claim provider termination. Idle reclamation cause remains unknown without provider evidence.
source_review.scope_and_receipts: T4-only synthetic fixture; no native games, training frames, seed cohorts, trained weights, evaluation, or promotion. Receipt validation binds nonce, payload, checkpoint, model/Adam fingerprints, source/runtime origins, numeric tolerances, memory measures, and watchdog absence.
source_review.acceptance_and_release: Receipt retrieval precedes exact endpoint release. Strict terminal acceptance checks accepted audit absence, failure/partial absence, exact receipts and lease; durable accepted audit precedes exact lease-to-null CAS under shared lock. Duplicate acceptance is rejected.
source_review.training_boundary: DODGE-058 remains reserved for separately reviewed A100 native training. T4 success does not qualify that work.
source_review.billing_limit: CU meter has no server timestamp or documented refresh cadence; observed debit plus elapsed ceiling estimate is conservative accounting, not a hard billing guarantee.
